result_text:
The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves cancelled purchase orders out. The full test suite passes. I didn't add a test for the cancelled case or check your January example.

The change is in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. The `PURCHASE_ORDERS` entry of the `CustomerAttributedRecords` enum now excludes `po.status = 'CANCELLED'`, the same way sales orders and invoices do. I also updated its comment. Reps with no purchase orders are still listed with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

**Per-country report changed too:** that enum entry is also used by `findPurchaseOrderCountPerCountry`, so the per-country purchase-order report now skips cancelled orders as well. I left it that way because it matches the other counts. If you want the country report to keep counting cancelled orders, say so and I'll split the two.
